Given these similarities in age estimates across the two fossil calibration scenarios, we focus on summarizing results from the 10-fossil calibration trees.' The set used is therefore data.vertlife.org/sharktree/10.cal.tree.nex (10,000 trees, sha256 0e447ede08914279332f8eb5a2d6bcdafe1ab7b5b1f00e00172886719b9e62e2). Both scenarios draw root ages from the same lognormal density (accepted MS pp.16-17); root height over the 10,000 trees: 10-fossil median 377.83 Ma, central 95% 353.57-437.61, range 348.76-488.29; 1-fossil median 377.82, 353.43-437.50, range 348.86-488.08 (rootages.py); the source's '349 - 488 MYA' is that range.
